sloka: आह्वये विश्वकर्माणमहं त्वष्टारमेव च ।आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि तत्र मे संविधीयताम् ॥ २.९१.१२॥
transliteration: āhvaye viśvakarmāṇamahaṁ tvaṣṭārameva ca ।ātithyaṁ kartumicchāmi tatra me saṁvidhīyatām ॥ 2.91.12॥

translations.english: I intend to provide hospitality for which I am invoking Visvakarma and Tvastara who builds houses. Let adequate arrangements be made.
